description: Apply contact group names to contacting pieces or bodies. This command traverses all contacts within the specified range and applies the contact group names to the pieces or bodies at the ends of each contact. By default, group names are applied to pieces (balls, clump pebbles, wall facets). Use the 'body' keyword to apply to bodies (balls, clumps, walls) instead. This is useful for propagating group assignments from contacts to the objects they connect. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround:
itasca.command('contact apply-group ...') - Python SDK does not provide direct apply-group functionality. Manual implementation requires:
1. Iterate through contacts
2. Get contact group name: contact.group(slot)
3. Get contact ends: contact.end1(), contact.end2()
4. Apply group to pieces/bodies: piece.set_group() or body.set_group()

Example:
for c in it.contact.list():
    group_name = c.group('Default')
    if group_name:
        c.end1().set_group(group_name, 'Default')
        c.end2().set_group(group_name, 'Default')

notes: This command APPLIES (copies) contact group names TO pieces/bodies, not the reverse
Default behavior: applies to pieces (balls, pebbles, facets)
Use 'body' keyword to apply to bodies (balls, clumps, walls)
If piece/body has multiple contacts with different group names, LAST contact group name wins
Default slot behavior: contact slot → same piece/body slot
Can map between different slots using piece-slot or body-slot keywords
More efficient than Python iteration for bulk group propagation
Useful for organizing model based on contact topology
Related commands: contact group, ball group, wall group, clump group, contact list
A piece or body touched by several differently-grouped contacts gets the group of whichever contact is traversed last - effectively non-deterministic. Restrict with the group keyword.

keywords.name: body
keywords.description: Specify that the contact group names are applied to bodies (i.e., clumps or walls as opposed to pebbles or wall facets).

keywords.name: body-slot
keywords.description: The contact group names are applied to the body slot s . By default the body slot is the same as the contact slot.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Specify that only the contact group name s is to be applied to pieces or bodies.

keywords.name: piece-slot
keywords.description: The contact group names are applied to the piece slot s . By default the piece slot is the same as the contact slot.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Apply the contact group names from slot s . By default, the contact slot Default is used.

examples.description: Apply all contact group names to pieces at contact ends using default slot. Use case: Propagate contact groups to pieces for subsequent range selection.
Apply contact group names to bodies instead of pieces. Use case: When working with clumps, apply groups to clump bodies rather than individual pebbles.
Apply group names only from contacts in 'boundary' group. Use case: Selective propagation from specific contact subset.
Apply only the 'specimen' group name from contacts to pieces. Use case: Propagate specific group name while ignoring others.
Apply groups from contact slot 'interface' to piece slot 'region'. Use case: Map contact groups to different piece slot for organization.
Apply contact groups to body slot 'assembly'. Use case: Organize bodies based on contact group assignments.
Apply group names only from ball-ball contacts. Use case: Selective propagation based on contact type.
